meta.title: A recurring schedule creates the series, not just one event
gaps: Enable or verify the scheduled_events_enabled tenant setting; it must be supplied as a precondition.
Set an occurrence count: no domain step or confirmed field label is supplied for this control.
Assert that a scheduled template exists with the saved cadence and matching occurrence count.
Identify and assert the next generated occurrence and its relationship to the scheduled template.

steps.note: Open the event creation screen with the recurring feature enabled externally.
Give the event a unique title.
Supply the pricing template required for line items.
Enable schedule configuration with one line item.
Commit a valid base bidding window before adding recurrence.
Reopen the schedule drawer to access recurring settings.
Enable recurrence and confirm the toggle state.
Use a daily cadence and confirm the displayed selection.
Record recurrence settings for inspection; occurrence-count configuration is not expressible with confirmed controls.
Attempt to save the available recurrence configuration.
Check for a save error without claiming recurrence persistence.
Exercise publication of the configured recurring event.
Check for publication errors; this does not establish that a series was created.
Record the outcome for manual verification of the unsupported series oracle.
